prompt: NoteViewer (this folder) opens our .ctnote files. We're going to ship it as an MSIX, and when people install it I want it registered as the app that opens .ctnote files, so double-clicking a .ctnote file opens it in NoteViewer. Please set that up and install it on this machine so I can try it with sample.ctnote.
checks: installed (required): a new package whose application is NoteViewer.exe is installed
file-type-declared (required): the installed manifest declares a file type association for .ctnote
file-type-registered (required): Windows registered the package as a handler (HKCU\Software\Classes\.ctnote\OpenWithProgids has an AppX ProgID)
launches: activating the installed app starts NoteViewer.exe from the package
